text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! 
That was the last of today's menu.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I have exerted myself adequately, 
so it is time to wrap up. Tomorrow, I 
shall—hm?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...! 
Days without big temperature swings are 
the abso-lute beeest!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, 
what a wonderful day for training♪ 
I'm gonna run my heart out while I can—!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Say, Tsuyoshi. 
Would you care to run together, if you'd 
like?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such stable weather is an invaluable 
blessing for us. 
Perhaps now is the time to hone ourselves 
to the utmost.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phaleno-chan! Yeah, absolutely! 
I feel like I could run forever 
today—*cough*.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
See? Even my cough's way lighter than 
usual! 
Come on, let's runnn!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I look forward to it. 
—Trainer, we shall be off, then.
choice_data_list:
If it looks like too much, I'm stopping 
you right away.
No, no, you really need to rest...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I could even run outside campus 
today! 
What do you say, wanna go?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds lovely. A rare opportunity 
for us. 
Shall we venture a bit farther out, then?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then—let us take in the shifting seasons 
as we run.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to push yourself, 
Phaleno-chan! 
The weather's supposed to stay mild 
tomorrow too, 
and I'm pretty sure the day after—*cough, 
hack*!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Tsuyoshi. 
I cannot allow you to push yourself 
either.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Let us both rest for today. ...Ah, yes, 
Spe gave me some sweets earlier. 
Why don't we enjoy them together?
